statement.zh: 故其弟子之徒，莫得有所述於後世也

translationRepairs: In the first month of the second year, on bingchen day Mars encroached upon the second star of Room.
In the first month of the second year, on bingshen day Mars encroached upon the second star of Room.
The Chinese date is 丙申 (bingshen), not 丙辰 (bingchen); the before text misreads the earthly branch 申 as 辰. Replacing with bingshen restores the correct sexagenary day.
Year 2, first month, day bingchen: Mars encroached upon the second star of Room.
Year 2, first month, day bingshen: Mars encroached upon the second star of Room.
The Chinese date is 丙申 (bingshen), not 丙辰 (bingchen); the literal’s bingchen misreads 申 as 辰. The proposed bingshen matches the source.
In the third month of the third year, on bingchen day Mars encroached upon the Chief Minister.
In the third month of the third year, on bingshen day Mars encroached upon the Chief Minister.
The Chinese date is 丙申 (bingshen), not 丙辰 (bingchen); the before text again confuses 申 with 辰. Bingshen is the correct reading.
Year 3, third month, day bingchen: Mars encroached upon the Chief Minister.
Year 3, third month, day bingshen: Mars encroached upon the Chief Minister.
The Chinese date is 丙申 (bingshen), not 丙辰 (bingchen); the literal’s bingchen is the same branch error. The replacement is accurate.
In the eleventh month, on wuzi day, the moon occulted the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
In the eleventh month, on wuzi day, the moon occulted the great star of Xuanyuan.
The Chinese names 軒轅, not 軫; adjacent s0120 correctly renders 軫 as Chariot Shaft, so applying that name here invents the wrong asterism. Xuanyuan matches 軒轅.
Eleventh month, day wuzi: the moon occulted the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
Eleventh month, day wuzi: the moon occulted the great star of Xuanyuan.
The Chinese is 軒轅大星; Chariot Shaft is the rendering of 軫 (as in s0120), not of 軒轅. Xuanyuan is the correct asterism name.
In the eighth month of the sixth year, on xinmao day, Venus encroached upon the Chariot Shaft.
In the eighth month of the sixth year, on xinmao day, Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.
The Chinese target is 軒轅; Chariot Shaft would require 軫. Replacing with Xuanyuan corrects the asterism identity.
Year 6, eighth month, day xinmao: Venus encroached upon the Chariot Shaft.
Year 6, eighth month, day xinmao: Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.
The Chinese target is 軒轅; the literal’s Chariot Shaft wrongly maps a different mansion (軫). Xuanyuan is accurate.
On yisi day the moon occulted the Crown Prince.
On yisi day the moon occulted the Secondary Son.
The Chinese star is 庶子, not 太子 (Crown Prince); Secondary Son correctly names the Heart-mansion star indicated by 庶子.
Day yisi: the moon occulted the Crown Prince.
Day yisi: the moon occulted the Secondary Son.
The Chinese is 庶子, not 太子; the literal’s Crown Prince invents the wrong Heart star. Secondary Son restores the source naming.
In the sixth month, on yiyou day, the moon occulted the Crown Prince of Heart;
In the sixth month, on yiyou day, the moon occulted the Secondary Son of Heart;
The Chinese is 心庶子, not 心太子; Crown Prince of Heart misidentifies the star. Secondary Son of Heart matches 心庶子.
Sixth month, day yiyou: the moon occulted the Crown Prince of Heart;
Sixth month, day yiyou: the moon occulted the Secondary Son of Heart;
The Chinese is 心庶子, not the Crown Prince (太子) of Heart; Secondary Son of Heart is the accurate rendering.
In the seventh month, on jiayin day, the moon occulted the Crown Prince star of Heart.
In the seventh month, on jiayin day, the moon occulted the Cadet star of Heart.
The Chinese is 心庶子星, not 太子; Crown Prince wrongly substitutes 太子. Cadet star of Heart correctly distinguishes 庶子 from the Crown Prince star.
Seventh month, day jiayin: the moon occulted the Crown Prince star of Heart.
Seventh month, day jiayin: the moon occulted the Cadet star of Heart.
The Chinese is 心庶子星; Crown Prince would be 太子. Cadet star of Heart accurately renders 庶子星.

Saturn had entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure on jichou day in the eighth month of year 1, encroaching upon the Supreme General, the Law-Enforcers, the Inner Screen, and the Petitioner, and traced hooked retrograde loops until it emerged in the eleventh month of that year, on xinhai day.

Saturn had entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure on jichou day in the eighth month of year 1, encroaching upon the Supreme General, the Law-Enforcers, the Inner Screen, and the Petitioner, and traced hooked retrograde loops until it emerged in the eleventh month of this year, on xinhai day.
是歲 means the narrative present year, not the entry year (元年); “that year” collapses exit into year 1 and conflicts with the stated 四百四十三日 span. “This year” restores 是歲.

Queller from year 1, eighth month, day jichou entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, encroaching upon the Supreme General, Law-Enforcer, Inner Screen, and Petitioner; it moved in hooked loops back and forth, until the eleventh month xinhai of that year when it exited.

Queller from year 1, eighth month, day jichou entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, encroaching upon the Supreme General, Law-Enforcer, Inner Screen, and Petitioner; it moved in hooked loops back and forth, until the eleventh month xinhai of this year when it exited.
是歲 is “this year” relative to the year-2 narrative, not “that year” (=元年). The proposed this year matches the Chinese deixis.
